value.text: Hi! Registration for Ada's swim lessons opens Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. Eastern. Hale saw two sessions: Preschool Swim Sat 9:00 (Jan 9, 9:00 to 9:45 a.m., $98) and Preschool Swim Sun 10:00 (Jan 10, 10:00 to 10:45 a.m., $98). If you'd like, Hale can join the open for you, like a punctual parent would, take the first session on your list that still has a spot, and pay with the card already saved on your city account, never more than your maximum. To set that up, tell Hale which sessions you want in order of preference, the most you're willing to pay, and whether Hale may tick the town's activity waiver at checkout. One thing to know: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, your family holds two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place. The registration link follows this message in case you'd rather do it yourself.
